source: User-approved single-command DLL plan, 2026-09-14; src/exports.cpp and scripts/package.ps1
summary: Only WM_StartMapping is exported (14 arguments; replace old 12-argument stdcall declarations). All settings are copied at startup; changes require closing and starting again. A session owner joins UI/render threads, destroys Engine, then releases its temporary DLL reference with FreeLibraryAndExitThread. Delivery is exactly GameWindowMapper.dll and 使用说明.md under output; tests and developer assets stay in the repository.
title: Single entry, automatic close cleanup, two-file delivery

source: src/engine.cpp; tests/native_tests.cpp same-module restart regression; linker map fault RVA 0x4B2B in GraphicsCaptureSession::IsSupported
summary: Keeping GameWindowMapper.dll loaded after closing the first canvas caused an access violation on the second start at GraphicsCaptureSession::IsSupported: C++/WinRT retained a cached factory whose implementation was invalid after the prior render thread's final CoUninitialize. Destroy capture and graphics objects, clear_factory_cache, then CoUninitialize on normal and startup-failure exits. Regression must cover closing/restarting without unloading the host DLL; unloading/reloading each cycle alone missed this bug.
title: Clear WinRT factory cache before ending the capture COM lifetime

source: User screenshot and examples/用户测试.e; embedded JPEG equals examples/黑.jpg at byte offset 793; src/exports.cpp and graphics.cpp
summary: The user passes #pic directly as StartMapping argument 13, but the initial single-entry parser treated every nonempty buffer as a versioned configuration, and image decoding excluded JPEG. Accept raw PNG/BMP/JPEG signatures as a global fallback before parsing advanced config and enable JPEG in WIC. The 14-argument ABI stays unchanged. Verify same-host close/restart with the actual picture constant; separately report invalid current HWNDs without assuming their past validity.
title: E-language picture constants must work without a configuration wrapper

summary: WindowParking records WINDOWPLACEMENT separately from physical GetWindowRect, marks the HWND lifetime before capturing placement, and durably persists the record before moving. Recovery verifies PID creation time/TID/class/cookie and observed geometry; a failed move, hung target, or journal write must retain recoverable state. Original/virtual display identities are recorded because display numbering and topology may change. Tested with owned x64 and x86 windows; virtual driver/WGC compatibility is separate.
title: Window parking recovery keeps coordinate and lifetime ownership explicit

summary: In the packaged desktop test host, PrepareRuntimePayload uses a logical LocalAppData path while QueryFullProcessImageName returns the physical MSIX LocalCache path. String equality rejected the legitimate helper with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED. RecoveryClient now opens the verified helper and process image read-only and compares FILE_ID_INFO volume and file identifier. Real embedded x86-to-x64 recovery integration passes without weakening server authentication.
title: Verify recovery broker by file identity across AppData redirection

summary: DisconnectNamedPipe can discard an unread reply; the recovery protocol now requires a bounded client acknowledgement after reading the complete reply instead of an unbounded FlushFileBuffers. A one-instance pipe is briefly absent between connections, so non-Ping operations retry open through FILE_NOT_FOUND/PIPE_BUSY gaps. Operation errors are separate from display initialization status, and idempotent registration tolerates a durable write exceeding the first reply budget.
title: Bounded pipe delivery and retry protect recovery requests

summary: Valid CAT/DLL Authenticode and signtool /pa catalog validation did not by themselves satisfy this machine's first device installation trust. Noninteractive SetupAPI initially failed unknown-publisher policy; allowing Windows publisher confirmation and the user's approval installed the unmodified driver. Do not import a root certificate or weaken signing policy. A newly created own device may auto-enable clone mode; detach only that new, unoccupied own path before establishing a nonprimary extension. Existing device repair must not blindly detach active sessions.
title: Driver installation trust and first display topology need separate checks

summary: A desktop DC can be readable yet return pixels from another app covering the tested canvas. This occurred even after a test-only topmost request; WindowFromPoint identified a different process, while the source client DC had the expected color. The single-entry regression now captures its own canvas HWND through WGC and reads its GPU pixels. Production remains GPU-only; no desktop screenshot fallback or skipped pixel assertions are used.
title: Canvas regression pixels must identify the canvas rather than the desktop
